name: artcraft-mcp
description: Unofficial: drive the open-source ArtCraft apps (PhotoCraft, VectorCraft, FilmCraft, LightCraft, PdfCraft, EffectCraft, DesignCraft) from Claude Code through their built-in MCP servers, with a tested skill per app. Not affiliated with the ArtCraft Team.

photocraft_read_root.title: PhotoCraft read root
photocraft_read_root.description: Folder PhotoCraft may read from; its tool paths are relative to it. Empty = $PHOTOCRAFT_READ_ROOT, else your home folder.

photocraft_write_root.title: PhotoCraft write root
photocraft_write_root.description: Folder PhotoCraft may write (and overwrite files) in; export paths are relative to it. Empty = $PHOTOCRAFT_WRITE_ROOT, else ~/PhotoCraft.
